title: Comtalk
tagline: Chat application using XMTP web 3 tech built by Jordan and Victor
description: Chat application using XMTP developed by Jordan and Victor. The goal of this app is to help connect people together using a secure messaging protocol and a decentralized communication network. This chat app is inspired by big app's like discord, facebook messenger, Instagram chat, WhatsApp, etc.
how_its_made:
Chat application using XMTP developed by Jordan and Victor.
XMTP is a useful application for building a communication app because it has a secure messaging protocol and a decentralized communication network for web 3. Considering the amount of time and effort we put in due to personal reasons we're quite happy with what we built for ETHOnline.
